scope: Comparison40-v2 common fixed-repair behavior with a predeclared physical boundary attempt-enter administrative barrier. Sole coordinator stops admission beyond each G25+5k<140 boundary until the same-session/profile/current-slot HQ ACK arrives after original timing qualification and before original decision_callback/NN. No business payload, observation-content readiness, ideal input, extra executor, HOLD/RUN or wall deadline reanchor. Original absolute pace40 token deadlines, 2wall progress protection, pacing qualifications and stop ownership remain; barrier waits are not subtracted from wall/RTF/lateness. Explicit new cohort; comparison40-v1 discoveries remain separate.

startup_contract.readiness: initialized gate received through original flow95; original readiness and no-motion safety only
startup_contract.first_slot: unchanged original allocation ATTEMPT, including awaiting observations or WAIT; no NN/candidate content admission
startup_contract.late_slot: record actual; timing failure; no backdate, catch-up or moving epoch
startup_contract.end: new decision and original send_goal entry permission [25,140); actual timestamps preserved, previously admitted inflight/feedback/cancel/stop ownership unchanged; not DDS send/acceptance timestamp

evaluation_stop: Original budget-only legal stop; quality-valid T95 is independent post-exit evaluation only.

nav2_goal_guard.reason: same2sim order as existing state freshness; stale map cannot trigger new invalidation and does not extend health guards

attempt_entry_barrier.release: same-session/profile/current-slot/actual-C-clock ACK before original decision_callback; not callback completion
attempt_entry_barrier.timeout: original 2wall progress limit, no added budget; missing first ACK is also bounded
attempt_entry_barrier.pacing: absolute40wall-ms deadlines unchanged; no reanchor/no hold-time subtraction; original qualifiers retained
attempt_entry_barrier.stop: authority-exited STOP_COUPLED/FAULT_STOP_OBSERVE bypasses allocation barrier for actual cleanup
